hint.ok: The key value is never shown

flagOff.title: AI off — switched off on the server
flagOff.text: The «With AI» tab is hidden when creating an order; orders are created manually. To turn it on, enable AI_ORDER_ENABLED in the server settings.

keyMissing.title: AI off — key not configured
keyMissing.text: The «With AI» tab is hidden when creating an order; orders are created manually. To turn it on, add ANTHROPIC_API_KEY to the server settings.

keyMisnamed.title: AI off — wrong key name
keyMisnamed.text: The key is set on the server under a different name, so AI cannot see it. It must be set as ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. Until then the «With AI» tab is hidden when creating an order.

disabled.title: AI off
disabled.text: The AI service is off. The «With AI» tab is hidden when creating an order; orders are created manually.

weak.title: Weak model: order parsing quality will drop
weak.text: {{purpose}}, {{model}} is selected — it is too weak for this job. Finding the region from the district and calculating the price may go wrong.
weak.fixOn: Switch to a stronger model in the server settings — AI keeps working until then.
weak.fixOff: Switch to a stronger model in the server settings.

unknownModel.title: Unknown model: {{purpose}}
unknownModel.text: {{model}} is not in the price table — the name may be misspelled.
unknownModel.impactOff: Once AI is on, these calls will fail.
unknownModel.fix: Check the model name in the server settings.

capExceeded.title: Daily limit reached — AI is off until 00:00
